data.name: San Diego Tours:Baja Lobster, Art and Vibes Tour from San Diego (Private)
data.description:
Escape the city for a vibrant day along the Baja California coast with our Baja Lobster, Art & Surf Vibes Tour. This 8-hour journey blends colorful street art, local craftsmanship, beach time, and the iconic flavors of Baja-style lobster in the seaside village of Puerto Nuevo.

Discover murals, meet local artisans, enjoy laid-back beach vibes, and indulge in a delicious coastal meal—all in one unforgettable cross-border experience. Perfect for small groups, curious travelers, and anyone looking to experience Baja’s unique mix of surf culture, art, and culinary tradition.
data.highlights:
Cross the border seamlessly with private round-trip transportation from San Diego

Explore Rosarito’s street murals and urban art installations

Visit artisan markets and meet local craftsmen

Relax with free time on Rosarito’s beach

Visit Puerto Nuevo, the famous lobster village

Optional lobster lunch at a local seaside restaurant (not included)
data.itinerary:
9:00 AM – Pick-Up in San Diego
Meet your bilingual guide and begin the scenic drive to Rosarito.

10:30 AM – Arrival in Rosarito
Enjoy a guided walk through colorful street murals and local art spaces.

11:30 AM – Artisan Market Visit
Explore handmade crafts and meet talented local vendors.

12:30 PM – Beach Time
Relax on the beach, soak up the sun, or enjoy a drink by the shore.

2:00 PM – Puerto Nuevo Lobster Village
Visit the seaside village and enjoy an optional lobster lunch with ocean views (meal not included).

3:30 PM – Return Journey
Depart Puerto Nuevo and head back to the U.S. via the Fast Pass lane for aditional fee of $85.

5:00 PM – Drop-Off in San Diego

meeting_point.address: San Diego San Diego, CA US

data.what_is_included:
Private round-trip transportation from San Diego

Bilingual local guide

Stop at Puerto Nuevo Lobster Village

Personal expenses

data.cancellation_notes:
There are no refunds. All tours are subject to cancellation if we do not meet the minimum number of participants. In the event of cancellation on our end, you will receive an email notification and a full refund will be issued via the original method of payment.

Please note:

A valid passport is required to cross the U.S.–Mexico border. Failure to present valid travel documentation will result in denied entry, and no refunds will be issued.

Thank you for your understanding.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking the Baja Lobster, Art & Surf Vibes Tour with us! We’re excited to share the vibrant culture and coastal charm of Baja California with you.

Your bilingual guide will meet you at your confirmed pick-up location at 9:00 AM. Please be ready at least 10 minutes prior to departure.

This 8-hour experience includes a guided art walk in Rosarito, visits to local artisan markets, beach free time, and a stop in Puerto Nuevo, the famous lobster village.

Lobster lunch is not included and will be paid directly at the restaurant of your choice in Puerto Nuevo.

Bottled water will be available.

Don’t forget your valid passport—you’ll need it to cross the U.S.–Mexico border.

Please wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a hat, and cash or card for personal purchases and meals.

Gratuities for your guide and driver are not included but appreciated.

We look forward to providing you with an unforgettable Baja experience!
